evidence: Same addresses as .155's owner source. sub_C3F0934 is uv_timer_init(loop, timer): type 13 at +8, flags 8 at +44, cb/timeout/repeat cleared at +48/+64/+72 (the 88-byte .155 handle).

sub_C4FBB24 restarts the 'miwear-refresh' timer 0x200C19B8 (flags word 0x200C19E4 = +44) with uv_update_time(*0x200C36B8) then sub_C3F0A6E(timer, cb, uint64 timeout, uint64 repeat): uv_timer_start on the UI owner loop.
sub_C4FB31C (the refresh callback) re-arms through the same sub_C3F0A6E; dword_200C36B8 is passed as the loop throughout (sub_C4FB130, sub_C4FB3CC, sub_C4FCD80).
TIMER / TIMER_DELETE are the target's lv_timer_create / lv_timer_del (CANOPUS_FW_LV_TIMER_CREATE / _DEL), identical to .155.
scope: Owner pump only: background timers (screen-off) on the UI owner loop. No L2 transport: SAR RX/session/crypto/send are not recovered for this target.
constraints: uv_timer_init/start mutate owner-loop lists and heaps; only the LVGL bootstrap callback on the UI owner initializes and starts the resident handle, and its callbacks run on that loop. No threads or work queues.
Static recovery from the exact firmware IDB; no emulator or physical-device validation yet.
